title: This PS2 Lighthouse Game Shows One Extra Boat #shorts
desc:
LAMPLIGHT, an unreleased PS2 lighthouse keeper game. One rule: count the boats on every sweep. If there's one more than you counted, put the light out. Every night I counted nine lamps. The game said eight.

Full story on the channel: The PS2 Lighthouse Game That Counts One Boat Too Many (LAMPLIGHT, Dead Pixel Studios).

Fiction. PS2-era low-poly visuals, synthetic narration.
#shorts #analoghorror #ps2 #lostmedia
